product_metadata.title: JACARANDA Disposable Bathtub Cover Liner, Large Bathtub Liner Plastic Bag for Salon, Household and Hotel Bath Tubs (102 x47 Inch)
features: 🛁【6 PACKS SET】There are 6 packs of disposable bathtub cover liner in the package.Each piece bathtub cover is individually packed, clean, sanitary and convenient to use. Completely get rid of the trouble of sharing a bathtub for many people, clean and sanitary, providing a safe and healthy bath environment.Each bathtub bag only use a once.

🛁 【LARGE SIZE】The size of this disposable bathtub cover liner is approximately 102 x47x36 inch,fits for most for standard size bathtubs, single bathtubs, double bathtubs and casks. Before you use the bathtub bag, please spray some water into bathtub,and then the disposable bags will stay in the tub. If it is a child bath, need to the adult accompany.

🛁 【 SELF ADHESIVE DOTS INCLUDED 】Come with 6 pcs self adhensive tape each bathtub bag, no more worry about the bathtub cover moving, use a waterproof double-sided tape to secure the bathtub bag disposable to the bathtub.
🛁 【HIGH QUALITY】Made of high quality brand new HDPE plastics materials,with good heat resistance and cold resistance.It is thickened,sturdy,waterproof,odorless,safe to use.

🛁【WIDELY USE】 This disposable bathtub bag is portable and lightweight,convenient to carry,suitable for travel use. It can be used on salon bathtubs, wooden barrel, hotel bathtubs and household bathtubs.Both adults and children can use it.
description: Thickened film by new material, high temperature resistance, good toughness and not easy to break.These bathtub cover can protect from possible contaminants in public bath houses. Each bathtub bag only use a once.
